leads.title: ILGA-Europe 2025 Rainbow Europe Index
leads.documents: Comparative LGBTQ rights legislation ranking; Estonia ranks 21st of 49 European countries, lower than Finland/Sweden but higher than other Baltics and UK.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as "According to ILGA-Europe's 2025 Rainbow Europe Index, Estonia ranks 21st among 49 countries"

leads.title: Equal Treatment Act (Vorðse kohtlemise seadus)
leads.documents: Transposition of EU directive banning discrimination based on sexual orientation in employment from 1 May 2004; entered into force 1 January 2009, covers employment but not goods and services.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited with Estonian title Võrdse kohtlemise seadus, dates 1 May 2004 and 1 January 2009

leads.title: Gender Equality Act (Soolise vordoiguslikkuse seadus) - Gender Equality and Equal Treatment Commissioner interpretation
leads.documents: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of sex/gender since 1 May 2004 extends to transgender and non-binary individuals; covers less favourable treatment in connection with gender, gender-based harassment, dress matching gender identity, ID mismatch at interviews.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited via Commissioner statement and Estonian terms otsene sooline diskrimineerimine, muude soolise kuuluvusega seotud asjaoludega

leads.title: Penal Code (Karistusseadustik) - Paragraph 151 incitement to hatred
leads.documents: Since 2006 prohibits public incitement to hatred on basis of sexual orientation; June 2023 government draft bill to explicitly ban hate speech based on sexual orientation and gender identity, passed first reading Sept 2023.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as paragraph 151, draft by Ministry of Justice sent to Riigikogu

leads.title: Estonian Human Rights Centre on hate-speech enforcement
leads.documents: Institutional assessment that incitement to hatred is prohibited by paragraph 151 but extraordinarily difficult to use in court due to wording requiring danger to life, health or property.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as "According to the Estonian Human Rights Centre, incitement to hatred is already prohibited by paragraph 151"

leads.title: Family Law Act (Perekonnaseadus) marriage equality amendment
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex marriage and joint adoption; government draft May 2023, passed 20 June 2023 (55-34 second reading), signed 27 June by President Alar Karis, took effect 1 January 2024; Registered Partnership Act implementing provisions fully implemented.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited with dates 15 May, 22 May, 20 June 2023, 1 Jan 2024; first marriage 2 Jan by Tallinn Vital Statistics Department

leads.title: Ministry of the Interior confirmation December 2021 on transgender marriage
leads.documents: Transgender people can change legal sex while remaining married; if preconditions met at time of marriage it is not automatically invalid; several same-sex marriages resulting from sex reassignment by 2021; not contrary to Estonian public order.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as Ministry spokesman statement on changes to Family Law Act July 2014 petition to annul

leads.title: Common Requirements for Medical Operations for Gender Reassignment regulation + Vital Statistics Registration Act (Perekonnaseisutoimingute seadus)
leads.documents: Current legal gender recognition machinery: application to Ministry of Social Affairs for medical expert committee, ministerial decree for HRT (no longer mandatory since Feb 2022, no genetic testing, no forced sterilization), surgery permitted after 1 year but not required since April 1997, second committee appointment for Population Register correction via county town local government; minors access to puberty blockers; Names Act for name change.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as regulation in force since May 1999, Vital Statistics Act in force Jan 2014, decree of Minister Tiiu Aro 24 April 1997, new committee July 2021 by Minister Tanel Kiik, 186 people 1999-2021

leads.title: Tallinn Circuit Court ruling December 2016 - same-sex marriage registration
leads.documents: Court-ordered recognition/registration of same-sex marriage (two men married in Sweden) in Estonian population register after Harju County court refusal; registered late Jan 2017.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as December 2016 Tallinn Circuit Court ruling

leads.title: 14 July 2023 sentencing for murder of Jamaican trans woman in Tallinn + 11 June 2023 X-Baar hate crime
leads.documents: Documented anti-trans / homophobic violence enforcement: Russian-speaking man sentenced to 12 years for stabbing Jamaican trans woman 34+ times in 2022 after meeting in Tallinn Old Town bar; victim fled Jamaica 2009, open about identity; separate 11 June 2023 knife/punch attack at gay Christian event at X-Baar by 25-year-old Russian citizen charged with serious breach of public order, Interior Minister Lauri Laanemets on deportation.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited with dates 11 June 2023 and 14 July 2023, X-Baar location, police arrest at scene
